description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Earthquake

Through your bond with your shikigami, you have learned of its hunger for both flesh and battle, improving your teamwork even more:

  • When you or your centipede kill a creature within 5 ft, your centipede partially devours the corpse and regains hit points equal to your level + your CE modifier. At 11th level, your centipede can also feast on its cursed energy (unless it has none), causing you to regain 1 cursed energy.

  • You can spend 1 CE as a bonus action or as part of summoning it to give it temporary hit points equal to twice your level.
